title: Learning When to Think: Dual-Reference Offline Optimization for Adaptive VLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.09154v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reasoning traces improve vision-language models on complex multimodal tasks, but forcing every input to follow a long reasoning process leads to overthinking and unnecessary inference cost. We study adaptive fast/slow thinking for VLMs, where one model answers directly for simple inputs and reasons step by step when needed. Fast answers and slow traces often come from distinct behavior policies, making a single-reference offline objective misweight one mode. We propose DUAL-REFERENCE BOLT (DR-BOLT), which distinguishes the desired fast/slow mixture reference from the sampling distribution and corrects their mismatch in reward-weighted training. Fast/slow partition competition explains routing in the optimal target; an efficient source-wise correction approximates the exact objective when response formats are well separated. Matched Qwen3-VL comparisons use identical candidate banks to isolate the objective from slow-teacher quality.

translated_title: 学习何时思考：面向自适应视觉语言模型推理的双参考离线优化
translated_abstract: 推理轨迹能够提升视觉语言模型在复杂多模态任务上的表现，但强制每个输入都遵循漫长的推理过程会导致过度思考和不必要的推理成本。我们研究视觉语言模型的自适应快/慢思维，即同一模型对简单输入直接作答，而在需要时逐步推理。快答案和慢推理轨迹往往来自不同的行为策略，这使得单参考离线目标会对其中一种模式赋予错误的权重。我们提出双参考BOLT（DR-BOLT），该方法将期望的快/慢混合参考分布与采样分布区分开来，并在奖励加权训练中纠正二者的失配。快/慢划分竞争解释了最优目标中的路由机制；当响应格式良好分离时，一种高效的按来源修正方法可近似该精确目标。匹配的Qwen3-VL对比实验使用相同的候选库，以将目标函数本身与慢教师质量的影响隔离开来。
tldr: 提出DR-BOLT双参考离线优化方法，使视觉语言模型能够自适应地在快思考（直接作答）与慢思考（逐步推理）之间路由，解决了快慢模式源自不同行为策略时单参考目标的权重失配问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes DR-BOLT, a dual-reference offline optimization method that enables VLMs to adaptively route between fast direct answering and slow step-by-step reasoning, correcting the misweighting of single-reference objectives when fast/slow modes arise from distinct behavior policies.
